delivery.title: The ₱2 Load Trick: How Filipino Engineers Invented PasaLoad & Changed Global Telecoms
delivery.description: Back in 1999, the cheapest prepaid scratch card in Manila cost ₱300—a full day's wage. Here is the true story of how Filipino engineers used the GSM control channel's 160-byte free space and sari-sari store sachet culture to invent Over-The-Air micro-loading and PasaLoad!
